HYROX has apologized and introduced new rules after an Australian athlete was allowed to continue and win a Beijing race following a bowel accident. The incident sparked widespread concern over hygiene and safety after the athlete continued using shared equipment during the competition. Organizers said the affected areas and equipment were immediately isolated and disinfected, with contaminated items removed and the venue carpet replaced.
